## Description {#details}

<p>Assign ascending index for instructions in machine basic block.</p>


<p>The index can be used to determine dominance between instructions in same MBB.</p>


<p>Definition at line 68 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/regallocfast-cpp">RegAllocFast.cpp</a>.</p>
